title: Local Topology of Riemannian Manifolds with Lower Intermediate Ricci Curvature Bounds
summary: We prove a vanishing theorem for the local Betti numbers of closed, $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds with a lower volume bound, an upper diameter bound, and a lower intermediate Ricci curvature bound. This generalizes and interpolates between known results under lower sectional and Ricci curvature bounds. Moreover, the methods extend to open manifolds, yielding a corresponding vanishing theorem for the global Betti numbers.
